test_title: General intelligence and Reasoning Ability Mock Test 48

questions.question: Mr. Lee starts from Point A and drives 26 km towards the South. He then takes a right turn, drives 21 km, turns right and drives 31 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 25 km, turns right drives 2 km. He then takes a left turn drives 4 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 3 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (8 km to the West) है।

questions.question: This question is based on the following words.GUY  HAS  SHE  ATEHow many letters are there between the first letter of the first word from the right and the second letter of the first word from the left in the English alphabetical order?
Which of the given letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the following series to make it logically complete?EXM 3  HVO 6  KTQ 12  NRS 24  ?

Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. There are exactly four boxes kept between E and D. Only two boxes are kept between D and A. G is kept immediately above D. Only one box is kept between C and F. E is kept immediately below B. C is kept third from the top. Which box is third from the bottom?524
In a certain code language, ‘making good bread’ is coded as ‘mo dz bw’ and ‘stop making noise’ is coded as ‘dz hp km’. How is ‘making’ coded in the given language?

TUVW is related to ACCE in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, VAXC is related to CIEK. To which of the following options is QYSA related, following the same logic?
If ‘A’ stands for ‘+’ , ‘B’ stands for ‘−’, ‘C’ stands for ‘×’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘÷’, then what will come in place of question mark (?) in the following equation? 45 D 5 A 4 C 3 B 11 = ?

L, M, N, P, Q, R and S are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between Q and M when counted from the right of Q. Only three people sit between S and L when counted from the right of L. M sits to the immediate right of L. R sits to the immediate right of N. Who sits fourth to the right of P?

In this question, a statement (Cause) is given followed by possible effects numbered I, II and III. Read the Cause carefully and decide which of the two can be possible effect(s).Cause:A new factory manufacturing capital goods in the industrial park on the outskirts of City B has been operating around the clock for the past six months.Effects:I. The air quality in the surrounding sub urban residential area of City B has improved.II. Local employment rates in IT industry of City B have grown by 10% over the last four months.
options: Only II is a possible effect
Both I and II are possible effects
Neither I nor II are possible effects
Only I is a possible effect
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Neither I nor II are possible effects) है।

questions.question: ​In a certain code language, A+ B means ‘A is the mother of B’,A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’,A x B means ‘A is the wife of B’ andA ÷ B means ‘ A is the father of B’. How is Q related to T if ‘P ÷ Q + R – S × T’?
If ‘A’ means ‘×’, ‘B’ means ‘÷’, ‘C’ means ‘+’ and ‘D’ means ‘−’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?13 C 3 D 2 A 3 D 8 B 4 = ?

Each of P, Q, R, S, T, U and V has an exam on a different day of the week starting on Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. U has an exam on Thursday. Only one person has an exam between T and U. S has an exam on the day immediately before T but not on a Monday. Only two people have exams between S and V. P’s exam is on one of the days before R but on one of the days after Q. Who has an exam on Monday?

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:All pigeons are trees.Some trees are cloves.Some cloves are almonds.Conclusions:(I) Some almonds are pigeons.(II) Some cloves are pigeons.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.) है।

Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north. S sits fifth to the left of U. P sits third to the left of T. V sits fifth to the left of T. Only three people sit to the right of R. T sits second to the right of R. Who sits third to the right of S?

Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)(45, 24, 48)(59, 38, 76)

Two sets of numbers are given below. In each set of numbers, certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number result(s) in the second number. Similarly, certain mathematical operation(s) on the second number result(s) in the third number and so on. Which of the given options follows the same set of operations as in the given sets? (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)15 - 30 - 25 - 50;        10 - 20 - 15 - 30

Vivek starts from Point Y and drives 24 km towards the East. He then takes a right turn, drives 57 km, turns left and drives 15 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 38 km. He takes a left turn, drives 39 km. He then turns left, drives 18 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (37 km towards the North) है।
